idea: Gasoline price spike triggers consumer staples rotation
behavior: Weekly gasoline prices spike above 52-week moving average by >8%, signaling input cost pressure. Consumer staples stocks outperform discretionary on fuel shock.

market_impact.rationale: Staples are defensive and less price-sensitive; discretionary gets crushed on fuel/transport cost fears.

trade_logic.entry: If GASREGCOVW > (52-week MA + 8%), buy XLP and short XLY equally weighted
trade_logic.exit: Exit when GASREGCOVW drops below 52-week MA or after 15 trading days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Gasoline prices move weekly and spike above MA thresholds 3-4 times per quarter; highly observable in commodity markets.

idea: Mortgage application volume cliff signals real estate demand shock
behavior: Weekly mortgage applications drop >15% week-over-week from recent 4-week average. This signals rapid demand destruction in housing and consumer confidence.

market_impact.rationale: Real estate demand implosion directly impacts REITs, construction, and home-building equity values.

trade_logic.exit: Exit after 10 trading days or when MMNRNJ recovers above 4-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Mortgage application volatility is high; 15% drops occur monthly in seasonal and rate-shock cycles.

idea: Trucking freight tonnage collapse signals industrial recession

data.source: FRED series TOTALSA (weekly total tonnage indexed)

behavior: Weekly trucking tonnage drops >7% from prior month average. Indicates demand contraction in goods movement and industrial activity.

market_impact.rationale: Freight collapse signals manufacturing slowdown, inventory destocking, and capex pullback.

trade_logic.entry: If TOTALSA < (prior 4-week MA * 0.93), short XLI and long defensive XLP
trade_logic.exit: After 12 trading days or when TOTALSA recovers above 3-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Freight tonnage is volatile and seasonal; 7% swings occur 4-6 times annually in normal cycles.

idea: Initial jobless claims spike triggers defensive rotation

data.source: FRED series ICSA (weekly initial jobless claims)

behavior: Weekly initial jobless claims rise >12% from prior week. Signals rapid labor market deterioration and recession risk.

market_impact.rationale: Job losses reduce consumer spending power; discretionary demand implodes while staples and healthcare remain sticky.

trade_logic.entry: If ICSA > (prior week * 1.12), short XLY and long XLP equally weighted
trade_logic.exit: After 14 trading days or when ICSA declines for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Jobless claims spike weekly and exceed 12% thresholds 1-2 times monthly on seasonal and economic shocks.

idea: Temperature extreme surge drives utility demand

data.source: Open-Meteo daily max temperature for major US cities (New York, Houston, Chicago, Phoenix)

behavior: Daily maximum temperature exceeds 95F in >3 major US cities simultaneously. Signals extreme cooling demand and utility load spike.

market_impact.rationale: Utilities profit from peak demand events; higher loads → higher peak pricing and revenue capture.

trade_logic.entry: If >3 major cities exceed 95F on same day, long XLU
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or when all cities drop below 90F for 2 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Summer heat waves occur regularly; multi-city 95F+ days fire 3-5 times per summer season.

idea: Oil price contango curve steepens on supply fear

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily prices for USO (crude oil ETF) and price_only adapter for historical volatility and roll spread

behavior: Oil futures curve steepens (front-month to 3-month spread widens >$2.50 per barrel) in single day. Signals supply tightness fear and storage building.

market_impact.rationale: Energy companies benefit from supply-constrained environments and higher futures expectations.

trade_logic.entry: If USO front-3mo spread > prior 20-day MA + $2.50, long XLE
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days or when spread contracts below prior 5-day MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Oil futures curve steepens 1-2 times weekly on supply shocks; $2.50 spreads occur in 2-3 week windows multiple times per quarter.

idea: Hospital admission rates spike signals healthcare spending urgency
behavior: Weekly hospital admissions rise >9% from prior week average. Indicates acute health events or epidemic pressure driving urgent healthcare demand.

market_impact.rationale: Healthcare spending spikes with admission urgency; hospitals, pharma, and insurers benefit from elevated utilization.

trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when HOSPNSA drops below 4-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Hospital admissions spike seasonally and on disease outbreaks; 9% jumps occur monthly in flu/RSV seasons.

idea: Copper price volatility spike signals industrial uncertainty

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily prices for COPX (copper miners ETF) via price_only adapter

behavior: Daily COPX volatility (20-day rolling standard deviation) exceeds 3.5%, signaling economic uncertainty and manufacturing demand shock.

market_impact.rationale: Copper volatility spike reflects industrial capex uncertainty; manufactures and industrials pull in capex under uncertainty.

trade_logic.entry: If 20-day COPX volatility > 3.5%, short XLI and long XLU (safe haven)
trade_logic.exit: After 11 trading days or when COPX volatility drops below 2.8%

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Copper volatility spikes 3-5 times quarterly on rate shocks and China growth data; 3.5% threshold fires 2-3 times per month.

idea: Lumber price rebound signals housing demand resurgence

data.source: FRED series DCOILWTICO (use as proxy for commodity cycle) and Yahoo Finance daily prices for LVL (lumber spot prices via commodity tracker)

behavior: Weekly lumber prices rise >8% from prior week, signaling construction material demand acceleration and housing momentum.

market_impact.rationale: Lumber spikes signal homebuilding activity and construction starts; REITs and home builders rally.

trade_logic.entry: If LVL > (prior week close * 1.08), long XLRE
trade_logic.exit: After 9 trading days or when LVL drops below 5-day MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Lumber prices spike weekly on weather, demand, and supply shocks; 8% moves occur 2-3 times monthly seasonally.

idea: Corporate bond issuance surge signals credit confidence reversal

data.source: FRED series CORPORATEINVGRADESA (weekly corporate bond issuance)

behavior: Weekly corporate bond issuance volume doubles from prior month average. Indicates credit market confidence surge and refinancing window opening.

market_impact.rationale: Bond issuance surge signals credit market strength; financial and banking sectors benefit from underwriting fees and credit expansion.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly issuance > (4-week MA * 2.0), long XLF and short XLV (risk-on rotation)
trade_logic.exit: After 13 trading days or when issuance drops below 3-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Corporate issuance is lumpy but structural; 2x MA surges occur 2-4 times quarterly in normal credit cycles.
